traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Gymnosperm Database (Earle), Podocarpaceae (read 2026-10-16): leaves usually spiral, sometimes opposite; Araucariaceae spiral (family already states). One leaf per node in nearly all.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: Gymnosperm Database (Earle), Podocarpaceae (read 2026-10-16): usually spiral, sometimes opposite.

traits.leaf_division.note: Gymnosperm Database (Earle), Podocarpaceae (read 2026-10-16): leaves scale-like, needle-like or flat linear to lanceolate, never divided; Araucariaceae likewise.

traits.leaf_habit.note: Gymnosperm Database (Earle), Podocarpaceae (read 2026-10-16): evergreen shrubs or trees; Araucariaceae all evergreen. Replaces the inherited Pinidae value, whose 'deciduous rarely' has no member here.

traits.life_span.note: Gymnosperm Database (Earle), Podocarpaceae (read 2026-10-16): trees and shrubs.

traits.rosette.note: Gymnosperm Database (Earle), Podocarpaceae (read 2026-10-16): trees with leafy horizontal branches; no rosettes.
